# Security policy

CMDeck is an unofficial fork of T3 Code. Where to report depends on which code the problem is in.

- **Code CMDeck changed or added:** for example remote MCP tokens, the Cloudflare Tunnel address
  check, the importer from T3 Code, the local inference gateway, telemetry removal, the desktop
  tray, or this repository's CI. Report it privately with **Report a vulnerability** on this
  repository's [Security tab](https://github.com/Tehcnological/cmdeck/security/advisories/new).
- **Everything else, inherited unchanged from T3 Code:** report it to T3 Tools at
  [security@t3.codes](mailto:security@t3.codes) under their
  [security policy](https://t3.codes/security-policy). The fix lands here through the next
  upstream merge.

If you are not sure which applies, report it here.

Please do not disclose a vulnerability publicly until it has had a reasonable chance to be fixed.
